motion.name: header-glass

motion.name: lens-glass
motion.purpose: Smaller lens with white edge and local text copies.

motion.name: home-reveal

motion.name: application-reveal
motion.purpose: Existing operating-page entry with authored/editable content exclusions.

motion.name: template-fade

motion.name: reveal-stagger
motion.purpose: Bounded reveal for homepage and operating content.

motion.name: home-hover
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer cards; reduced motion disables transforms.

motion.name: mist
motion.value: uTime × .12; independently anchored left/right soft fields
motion.purpose: White center/top clearance; not a physical fluid simulation.

motion.name: background-lifecycle
motion.value: pause offscreen/hidden; static reduced motion; min(DPR,1.5) × .65
motion.purpose: Low-power WebGL; two-sided static CSS fallback on failure/context loss.

motion.name: lens-layout
motion.purpose: ResizeObserver and font notifications do not cancel an unchanged journey; real layout changes retarget ongoing travel. Visibility/reduced-motion changes explicitly settle.

motion.name: theme-reveal
motion.value: 700ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); circular clip from the theme control
motion.purpose: Existing public Portfolio View Transition contract, with retained attribution; direct mode update under reduced motion or without the API. Latest intent/generation wins before a transition commits.

narrative.northStar: White space, black controls, purple mist
narrative.overview:
IAVSE pairs a white, spacious platform with black functional controls, licensed artistic headings, floating cards and naturally moving purple mist at both sides. The center stays quiet and white. The shared header has a transparent frame: brand at left, a centered frosted navigation capsule with a theme control beside it, and real account state followed by language at right. The same capsule remains visible on every viewport; compact layouts place navigation and theme on a second row. A travelling lens briefly enlarges the text beneath it. Purple belongs to decorative backgrounds; primary actions, selected labels, icons and links use neutral ink.

This specification records the implemented **shared visual migration**, not a claim that every page was rewritten. [The landing stylesheet](src/app/iavse-landing.css) owns homepage variants; [application styles](src/app/iavse-application.css), [glass controls](src/app/glass-controls.css) and [platform shell placement](src/app/iavse-shell.css) carry the shared world through existing functional layouts. The older [base integration](src/app/iavse-system.css) and [host bridge](src/app/rbp-bridge.css) remain implementation support; their superseded blue-gray palette is not a second current design direction. [Platform coverage and mechanisms](docs/platform-ui.zh-CN.md) record the actual route and content boundaries. The retained local homepage brief holds its task-specific composition decisions.

The earlier application baseline retains its [RBP Portfolio attribution](docs/portfolio-frontend.md), pinned at `1581b9b8e5876f60e5eb844970747506980c4412`. The shared glass controls and analytic mist are independently authored public website code. The user-provided fluid-glass reference was read only; its MIT license includes Commons Clause restrictions and must not be called plain MIT. No reference source or model is included in this implementation. [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) owns business, permission and license boundaries. Authored bodies, blog themes, canvas content and third-party previews retain their appearance and rights.
keyCharacteristics: White space, black functional controls and soft purple mist at both sides, with a white center.
Licensed ZCOOL XiaoWei headings, Cormorant wordmark and readable Geist body text.
An always-visible frosted navigation capsule and adjacent theme control, with the original brand and real account/language controls outside it.
Sliding glass selection with local text magnification and one accessible interactive label layer.
Floating white cards, fine-pointer hover and bounded viewport entry within existing workflows.
Explicit route, authored-content, accessibility and source/license boundaries.

rules.name: The Neutral Function Rule
rules.body: Use black neutral UI for primary actions, selected labels, links and icons in the light appearance; keep purple in decorative backgrounds and retain semantic feedback colors.

rules.name: The Frosted Navigation Rule
rules.body: Apply translucent glass, blur and a fine edge to the always-visible central navigation capsule, using its scoped light or dark roles. Keep the full header frame transparent, borderless and without a shadow; brand, account and language controls remain outside the capsule, with theme beside it.

rules.name: The Source Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep authored work and source previews recognizable and attributed. Fictional template fallbacks must remain labeled.

rules.name: The Readable Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Verify Chinese, English and Japanese at the real viewport width; local magnification must not replace readable base text or create duplicate accessible names.

dos: Do use white space, black neutral functional UI and purple decorative atmosphere across platform-owned surfaces.
Do keep the navigation capsule visible and frosted at every width, with theme beside it and real brand, account and language controls outside it.
Do keep natural soft mist on both sides, a white center, top clearance and gentle pointer response.
Do preserve each route's working layout and avoid duplicate public headers in administration or the blog editor.
Do verify Chinese, English and Japanese, compact labels and full accessible names, focus, both appearances, reduced motion and static fallbacks.
Do retain actual public content, useful empty states, labeled fictional examples and original source/license details.
donts: Don't describe shared visual migration as a rewrite or full visual acceptance of every page.
Don't restore purple action/selection/icon/link accents or extend the navigation capsule's glass surface across the brand and account areas.
Don't turn soft mist into mandatory high-contrast ribbons or one-sided color.
Don't style authored bodies, artboards, color swatches or third-party previews as platform UI.
Don't expose duplicate interactive labels, invent activity or simulate real account state.
Don't call DOM label magnification physical refraction, copy reference code/models, or call MIT plus Commons Clause plain MIT.
Don't import private Pro materials, revive the cancelled Cloudlight migration, expand a license or claim authorship of licensed fonts.
